capabilities: Read, search, write, and organize files, folders, and vault apps in shared vault Surfaces, with every earlier version kept.
description: Reads a vault file by its path, or a file inside an artifact, such as "/Apps/launch.artifact/index.html" where launch.artifact is a vault app. Text comes back as numbered lines: a line number, then a tab, then the line, numbered from 1, up to 2000 lines from offset. Raster images are shown to you; other binary files are described without their bytes. version reads an earlier version of the file, or of the artifact holding it; list them with list_vault_versions.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

name: read_vault_file
